lines.zh: 我踩着干裂的林地往前走
lines.en: I walk the cracked forest floor
The spikes on my back sway with my steps

lines.zh: 我走在 oriforest 的边缘
lines.en: I walk the edge of the oriforest
My claws scrape the gravel

lines.zh: 我抬头嗅了嗅源石的味道
lines.en: I lift my head and sniff for originium

lines.zh: 这地方的空气有股涩味
lines.en: The air here has a bitter tang
I step and pause, patrolling

lines.zh: 石头里的光跟着我一闪
lines.en: The glint in the rocks flashes as I pass
I go slowly around a clump of thorn grass
I feel no need to run
My tail sweeps shattered crystal aside
I move toward the sound
I walk between two clumps of thorn grass
I lie by the roots to rest
Every spike on my back stands ready
I listen to the rustle of the forest
The smell of originium calms me
I keep the shade by these roots.
I do not wish to move, only to watch

lines.zh: 草从我的肚子旁边长出来
lines.en: Grass grows up beside my belly

lines.zh: 我伏在枯叶里，只有棘刺在动。
lines.en: I lie in the dead leaves; only my thorns move.
The leaves here are all hard
I lick the dust off my forepaw
I wait for someone to come near
This whole wood is mine

lines.zh: 我能嗅到你身上铁的味道
lines.en: I can smell the iron on you
I rest my head on my paws
The wind rattles my spikes

lines.zh: 你身上没有源石的味道
lines.en: You carry no smell of originium
You come near me, what do you want
My spikes will not prickle unprovoked

lines.zh: 你的手别伸进我的毛里
lines.en: Do not put your hand into my coat
I have watched you a while
You walk this place too carelessly

lines.zh: 我背上的东西不是装饰
lines.en: What is on my back is not ornament

lines.zh: 我背上的尖棘，随步子一晃一晃。
lines.en: The spines on my back sway with each step.
Stand still, let me sniff
Your boots carry originium dust
I growl once, softly
I neither fear you nor dislike you
You are lucky to walk this path

lines.zh: 我这一身，是一点点长出来的
lines.en: Everything I am, I grew
How long do you mean to stay

lines.zh: 站远一点，我的刺有点长
lines.en: Stand back, my spikes reach far

lines.zh: 我认得每一个进林地的人
lines.en: I know everyone who enters this wood

lines.zh: 我身上的棘，一根根立着。
lines.en: Every spine on me stands upright.
I turn my head to look at you

lines.zh: 你没有恶意，我看得出来
lines.en: You mean no harm, I can tell
I step back and growl

lines.zh: 棘刺间掉了一撮毛，我甩甩身。
lines.en: Fur torn from between my thorns; I shake.
That landed on my shoulder
I clench my teeth and hold
Every spike on my back is up
It hurts, but I do not run
My thorns settle back; I growl.
I can bear this wound
Even my thorns remember your scent.

lines.zh: 这一下压到了我的刺根。
lines.en: That blow crushed the base of my spines.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻，棘刺先碰到它。
lines.en: I sniff it; my thorns touch it first.
The smell in your hand is unfamiliar
Put it on the ground, I will sniff
I am not as eager as other dogs
This smells a little like originium
I sniff, and lift my head again
Keep it, I can find my own
If you mean to feed me, set it down
I do not bite a hand that feeds

lines.zh: 这点东西，还不够我一口
lines.en: That is not one mouthful for me

lines.zh: 它在地上的样子更好看
lines.en: It looks better on the ground
Let me circle it once first

lines.zh: 这是我今天闻到的最好的东西
lines.en: Best thing I have smelled today
Do not put it away so soon

lines.zh: 吃了你的东西，我就得让路
lines.en: If I eat this, I have to give way
Let me smell it once more

lines.zh: 这味道留在我鼻子里了
lines.en: The smell has stayed in my nose
You hit my shoulder
My spike nearly caught you
A thousand thorns on my back; hands off.

lines.zh: 你的体温透过棘刺传过来。
lines.en: Your warmth passes through my thorns.
I barely moved
Do not press this close, you will get hurt

lines.zh: 棘刺擦过你，留了一道白痕。
lines.en: My thorns scrape you, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也不让
lines.en: We collided, and neither gave way
You stepped on my tail tip
I huff from my throat
Few of my kind in this originium wood
I smell another of my kind
Let me circle once and see
If we match, we walk together
My spikes make way first
Two of us patrolling this wood
There is no need for us to call
Its steps are steadier than mine
Lying down together is agreement enough
This wood is enough for the two of us
I take it up in my jaws
I will keep this hide

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西归先到的
lines.en: Dropped things go to whoever comes first
I lay it by my paw
This much I can carry
I can smell it is hide
It dropped on the path I walk
I press it, it is solid enough
I have no use for this, take it

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把它拱进树根下。
lines.en: I nose it under the tree roots.
The grass moved over there
I have raised my head
Something has entered my wood

lines.zh: 鼻子一皱，我往后退了半步。
lines.en: My nose wrinkles; I back off half a step.
I growl toward that direction

lines.zh: 我背上的刺全都立起来了
lines.en: Every spike on my back is up
You should not have come this far
I have fixed on that shadow
This wood is mine to watch

lines.zh: 棘刺划着草，我朝气味去。
lines.en: Thorns rake the grass as I follow the scent.
I press forward step by step

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就进一步
lines.en: Every step it retreats, I advance
I crouch low, thorns scraping the ground.
I move along the low brush

lines.zh: 源石的碎屑在我脚下响
lines.en: Crystal shards clink under my feet

lines.zh: 源石的碎屑在我脚下响。
lines.en: Originium fragments crunch under my feet.
My spikes point its way
I know this wood better than it does
It stops to breathe, I do not
A few steps more is enough
My thorns pierce first; then my teeth.
I drive my shoulder into it
The spikes on my back rake past
That bite landed solid
I shake my head and tear it away

lines.zh: 我的爪子按住它的胸口
lines.en: My claws pin its chest
It fell back two steps
That will make it remember
I let go and bite again
Now it carries the smell of blood

lines.zh: 我从 oriforest 的树影里站起来
lines.en: I rise from the shadows of the oriforest
The soil under me sparkles with crystal
I sniff this wood first
The originium smell is strong here
I shake off the dust

lines.zh: 我的刺在这里长得很齐
lines.en: My spikes grew in well here
One or two of us together is right
I have found my path
The wood knows my footsteps
I walk slowly toward the treeline
Fire singes my coat and I leap aside

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，刺扎进泥
lines.en: I roll down the slope, spikes into the mud
Water up my nose, I kick hard

lines.zh: 背上的棘刺扎进土里才停住。
lines.en: My back thorns dig into the soil to stop me.

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进我腿里
lines.en: Something flying sticks in my leg
That force makes my footing fail
No originium in sight, and I go hungry

lines.zh: 雷落在我刺上，浑身一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my spikes and numbness spreads

lines.zh: 虚空里没有林地可以巡
lines.en: No wood to patrol in the void
